name: PND1 Kor annual withholding return

name: Annual employment and working conditions report (Kor Ror 11)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.115/1 (inserted by LPA (No. 2) B.E. 2551; paragraph one replaced by LPA (No. 9) B.E. 2568 s.9, Royal Gazette vol.142 part 74 Kor, 7 November 2025, https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/documents/89818.pdf): an employer of ten or more files the report on employment and working conditions within January each year.

name: Keep the employee register and wage records

name: Register with the Department of Skill Development (Sor Tor 1)

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended B.E. 2557): an employer of 100 or more registers (Sor Tor 1, Sor Tor 4) when it reaches 100 employees. Department of Skill Development guidance:; Act section4 (state bodies excluded) and Ministry scope notice 9 April 2015 clause4 (specified seasonal agriculture, private schools, private higher education and non-profit foundations/charities excluded); official DSD manual กสพ.-01-2568 appendix p.25.

The triggering hire date is an operational verification due date, not a newly asserted statutory filing period or evidence of when the employer first reached the threshold.

name: Skill Development Fund contribution return (Sor Tor 2)

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended): an employer of 100 or more that did not train at least 50% of its average employees in the calendar year contributes 1% of the wage base for the shortfall and files Sor Tor 2 within March of the following year. Department of Skill Development guidance:; Act section4 (state bodies excluded) and Ministry scope notice 9 April 2015 clause4 (specified seasonal agriculture, private schools, private higher education and non-profit foundations/charities excluded); official DSD manual กสพ.-01-2568 appendix p.25.

definition.description: File the previous calendar year’s Sor Tor 2 return within March, including when no March payroll exists or current headcount has fallen below 100. The annual company calendar checks the reporting year’s month-end headcounts; reaching 100 in that year requires the annual review even after a later reduction. Verify the certified training, category and any contribution assessment; the task does not assume a contribution is due merely because it files the return.

Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended): training counted toward the 50% is certified within 60 days of the course ending and no later than 15 January of the following year. This January reminder does not replace the earlier 60-calendar-day deadline for each course; record each qualifying completed employee upskilling or retraining course as a workplace case on its actual completion date.

name: Apply for approval of the completed training course and costs

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Committee notice dated 21 September 2016, clause 4; Royal Gazette vol.133 special part 262 Ngor, 16 November 2016, pp.1–2. Electronic applications for employee upskilling or retraining courses and costs: within 60 calendar days after completion, including public holidays, and no later than 15 January of the following year. Ministry of Labour official copy: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2020/10/109.e-Service-ฝึกยกระดับ-ฝึกเปลี่ยนสาขาอาชีพ.pdf. DSD operational guidance for FY2567 (November 2023), printed p.175, confirms the same deadline: https://eit2.dsd.go.th/~qrcode/qr1/PLAN/Plan_2566.pdf.

definition.description: Open a separate case for each qualifying employee upskilling or retraining course for which course/cost approval is sought, using the actual course completion date as opened_on. File the application and supporting course, schedule and actual cost evidence within 60 calendar days, capped at 15 January of the next year. Recording the case does not establish eligibility or registrar approval; only certified training may be counted toward the annual target. This also supports eligible voluntary applications below the fund headcount threshold.
definition.when: row.kind == "SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_COURSE_COMPLETED"

name: Pay the provident fund late-remittance surcharge

references.title: Provident Fund Act s.10 paragraph 3, amended by Act No. 4 B.E. 2558 (2015): remittance later than three working days from wage payment bears a 5% monthly surcharge on the late contributions.

definition.description: Pay the provident fund surcharge: 5% per month of employee or employer contributions remitted late. Verify the fund assessment for the overdue amount and elapsed period; this task does not infer a part-month rounding convention.
definition.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "PVD_REMITTANCE" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

name: Pay the SSO late-remittance surcharge

references.title: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.49 para 1 (as amended by No. 4 B.E. 2558): a contribution not remitted, or short, by the s.47 day bears a surcharge of 2% a month of the unremitted amount from the day after it was due, at most the contribution itself; para 2: a contribution the employer failed to deduct is still the employer's to remit with the surcharge. Raised when the remittance is recorded paid after its due day; the surcharge is paid with it.

definition.description: Pay the SSO late-remittance surcharge.
definition.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "SSO_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

name: Pay the PND1 late-payment surcharge

references.title: Revenue Code s.27: tax not paid or remitted in time bears a surcharge of 1.5% a month or part of a month of the tax, from the day after the deadline to the payment day, at most the tax (0.75% within an extension). Raised when the PND1 remittance is recorded paid after its due day.

definition.description: Pay the PND1 late-payment surcharge.
definition.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "PND1_FILING" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

name: Deposit 25% of the year's WCF contribution (instalment payer)

references.title: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.16-17: an employer allowed to pay the WCF contribution by instalments (entity fact wcf_instalments, the SSO's approval) deposits 25% of the estimated year's contribution within January.

definition.description: Deposit 25% of the year's WCF contribution (instalment payer).

name: Pay the quarter's WCF instalment and report its wages

references.title: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.18: the instalment payer pays in four instalments a year, each within the month after its quarter ends, reporting the quarter's total wages.

definition.description: Pay the quarter's WCF instalment and report its wages.

name: WCF_LATE_SURCHARGE

references.title: Workmen’s Compensation Act B.E. 2537 s.46 para 1 (as amended by No. 2 B.E. 2561), Office of the Council of State translation published by the SSO

definition.description: Pay the Workmen’s Compensation Fund late-payment surcharge: 2% a month of the contribution not remitted, or short, from the day after its due day, at most the contribution itself. Raised when a WCF contribution task (the annual or additional contribution, the instalment deposit or an instalment) is marked done after its due day; the surcharge is paid with it.
definition.when: row.state == "DONE" && row.code in ["WCF_ANNUAL_CONTRIBUTION", "WCF_ADDITIONAL_CONTRIBUTION", "WCF_INSTALMENT_DEPOSIT", "WCF_INSTALMENT"] && has(row.done_on) && row.done_on != null && row.done_on > row.due_on

name: PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE

references.title: PDPA s.23 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

definition.description: Tell the new employee, before or when collecting their personal data, the purposes and lawful bases, what is collected and for how long it is kept, who it may be disclosed to, the controller's (and any DPO's) contact details and their rights.

name: PDPA_SENSITIVE_DATA_CONSENT

references.title: PDPA s.26 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

definition.description: Obtain the employee's explicit consent before collecting sensitive personal data — health (medical certificates), biometric data (face or fingerprint attendance), criminal records, religion, disability, trade union membership — unless a s.26 exception applies (e.g. occupational medicine or the assessment of working capacity required by law).

name: PDPA_BREACH_NOTICE

references.title: PDPA s.37(4) (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

definition.description: Notify the PDPC Office of a personal data breach without delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of becoming aware of it (unless it is unlikely to risk the persons' rights and freedoms); where the risk is high, notify the data subjects and the remedies without delay too. Raised when a PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case is opened on the day of discovery; due three days later.
definition.when: row.kind == "PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH"

name: PDPA_CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER

references.title: PDPA ss.28–29 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

definition.description: Before sending or transferring personal data abroad (a foreign parent, a cloud or payroll provider), confirm the destination has adequate protection under the PDPC's rules, or that a s.28 exception applies (consent after being told of the inadequacy, a contract with the employee, compliance with law), or that a s.29 group policy covers it. Raised when a PERSONAL_DATA_TRANSFER_ABROAD case is opened; due that day.
definition.when: row.kind == "PERSONAL_DATA_TRANSFER_ABROAD"

name: PDPA_PROCESSING_RECORDS

references.title: PDPA s.39 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

definition.description: Keep the record of processing — the personal data collected, the purpose of each category, the controller's details, the retention period, access rights and conditions, s.27 uses or disclosures, refused requests and the security measures — in writing or electronically, for the data subjects and the Office to check. Raised when the entity is created.

name: PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL

references.title: PDPA s.37(3) (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation); Accounting Act B.E. 2543 s.14

definition.description: Erase or destroy a former employee's personal data when its retention period ends (anonymise the profile: employment_profile_anonymise), unless keeping it is needed to establish or defend legal claims or to comply with the law. Raised on the exit; due on the record_retention date (five years after the exit year ends).
definition.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_LATE_SURCHARGE

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 s.31, replaced by Act No. 2 B.E. 2557 section 10; Royal Gazette vol.131 Part87 Kor, 26 December 2014, p.24 (PDF p.6), Department of Skill Development official copy:

definition.description: Pay the Skill Development Fund surcharge on a contribution paid after March: 1.5% a month of the amount unpaid or short, a remaining part-month of 15 days or more counting as a month. Raised when the year's contribution is recorded paid after its due day; the surcharge is paid with it.
definition.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_FUND_PAYMENT" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

name: Pay interest on a late Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Fund contribution

references.title: Persons with Disabilities Empowerment Act B.E. 2550 s.34 para 2: an employer who must pay the fund but does not pay, pays late or pays short "ให้เสียดอกเบี้ยในอัตราร้อยละเจ็ดครึ่งต่อปี" of the amount not yet paid in; Ministerial Regulation B.E. 2554 cl.5 para 2 as amended by No. 2 B.E. 2560: payment by 31 March each year. Office of the Council of State consolidated texts https://www.ocs.go.th/searchlaw/law-index/item/6494 and https://searchlaw.ocs.go.th/council-of-state/#/public/doc/ZDlTeDI5VEFDSGt3NkEzTXp4T0ludz09, read 2026-10-08.

definition.description: Pay interest at 7.5% a year on the fund contribution not paid, paid late or paid short, on the unpaid amount from the day after its 31 March due day to the day paid. Raised when the disability quota duty (met by paying the fund) is marked done after its due day; the interest is paid with it.
definition.when: row.state == "DONE" && row.code == "DISABLED_EMPLOYMENT_QUOTA" && has(row.done_on) && row.done_on != null && row.done_on > row.due_on

name: Post the workplace relocation notice

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraph 1; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

definition.description: Post a visible notice identifying affected employees, the new workplace and relocation date for at least 30 consecutive days before relocation. Record facts.relocation_on. If it is missing, this task is due immediately to establish the date; that fallback is a verification deadline.
definition.when: row.kind == "WORKPLACE_RELOCATION"
definition.due: has(row.facts.relocation_on) && row.facts.relocation_on != null && row.facts.relocation_on != "" ? add_days(row.facts.relocation_on, -30) : row.opened_on

name: Assess and pay relocation special compensation

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraphs 2-4; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

definition.description: Verify the employee’s written refusal within 30 days of the posted notice (or relocation if no notice) and substantial impact on ordinary family life. Employment ends on relocation; pay eligible special severance at least at the s.118 rate, and 30 days final wage in lieu where notice was not posted. Both payments are due within seven days of termination. Record facts.relocation_on; if missing, this task is due immediately to establish the date.
definition.when: row.kind == "RELOCATION_EMPLOYEE_REFUSAL"
definition.due: has(row.facts.relocation_on) && row.facts.relocation_on != null && row.facts.relocation_on != "" ? add_days(row.facts.relocation_on, 7) : row.opened_on

name: Petition the Labour Welfare Committee on disputed relocation refusal

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraph 5; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

definition.description: If disputing the employee’s stated reasons, petition the Labour Welfare Committee within 30 days after receipt of the employee’s written notification. Open this case on that receipt date.
definition.when: row.kind == "RELOCATION_EMPLOYER_OBJECTION"

name: Pay relocation compensation ordered or lodge the court challenge

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120/1 paragraphs 1 and 4; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

definition.description: Pay the compensation ordered within 30 days after learning the Labour Welfare Committee order, or lodge a court challenge within that period. An employer bringing the case must first lodge court security equal to the ordered payment. Open this case on the date the employer learns the order.
definition.when: row.kind == "RELOCATION_BOARD_ORDER"
